headline: No API changes break the bot today; the ideas word tilt alerts around what you keep by waiting, set your stop from how far your own winners dipped, and show how old each coin's EMA alignment is.

ideas.title: Tilt alerts that lead with what you keep
ideas.why: In a 2024 UCLA study, people chose the patient option more often when the reward was shown before the wait. Reword cooldown alerts the same way: "Keep your +6.20 today. Next entry at 14:32" instead of "15 min cooldown". It's a wording change in tilt.py and guard.py.

ideas.title: Stop distance from your own winners' worst dip
ideas.why: For each imported trade, use klines to measure how far it went against you before closing. /week then says "95% of your winners never dipped more than 0.6%". A stop just past that cuts losers early without killing winners, and shows when you held a loser far past that line.

ideas.title: "Late" flag from the age of the EMA alignment
ideas.why: Each scanner card shows how many 15m bars since EMA 9 crossed 21, and 1h bars since 20 crossed 50. A top mover whose alignment is 40+ bars (10h) old gets a "Late" flag, so you can tell a fresh trend from one that has already run while you slept.

sources.title: ScienceDaily – Chen, Zheng, Wang & Krajbich (2024): how choices are presented affects patience
Garvey & Murphy (2004) – Are Professional Traders Too Slow to Realize Their Losses?
